fields.definition:
Tracking targets are sorted in order from lowest to highest key value.  If too many targets are found, targets with the highest key values are dropped until we are under the limit.  

The keys used to sort targets are based on distance from the player and an FOV factor defined as the absolute value of the sine of the angle between the camera facing and camera-to-object vectors.  The following fields serve as coefficients or weights in the equation used to calculate a target's key value.  

	D = distance from player's unit
	F = FOV factor

	a = distance weight
	b = blended weight
	c = FOV weight

 	key(D,F) = (a * D) + (b * D * F) + (c * F)

If all three weights are left at 0, then the blended weight will default to 1

Per Priority Default Ranges
fields.definition: The following list defines the default ranges at which objects can be hit with a ping. The list contains one default, per priority.  They are ordered by increasing priority, from low to critical, so for example, the range for highest priority trackables should be entered under "0. DefaultRangeBlock".

fields.name: Per Priority Tracking Limits
fields.definition: The following list defines the maximum number of objects to be tracked per priority.  Limits are ordered by increasing priority, from low to critical, so for example, the limit for highest priority trackables should be entered under "0. DisplayMaximumsBlock".

ping effect 2&team Chief (cracked visor) active ping effect#this effect is used when the spartan uses their tracking device
ping recharge time&active ping recharge time:seconds#minimum time (in seconds) between successive pings
